Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <5g1br3$fak$1...@panther.rmplc.co.uk>,
Bishop Vesey's Grammar <vese...@rmplc.co.uk> wrote:
> [Darius] specifically states that it can be directed at *any* Methuselah.
>
> However, I don't like the way it has been resolved - you can't because
> (D) actions can't be directed at yourself unless the card specifically
> over-rules this.
>
> Darius' wording *does* over-rule this.

By this logic, Darius's wording would allow him to take the
action even when empty (since it says he can take this action).
This is obviously not the case.

By not explicitly overcoming the restriction (against taking a
self-directed (D) action, or against taking any non-hunt action
when empty), card text *fails* to overcome the restriction.
